task_title: Resolve CI recovery duplicate reply markers

plan_review.notes: Independent devops investigator launched before code reviewed PR #3206 evidence and candidate root causes. It converged on the implemented plan: effective latest-comment logic should treat the exact trusted duplicate-skip no-op as transparent while preserving reviewer-follow-up blocking; recommended state and reconcile regressions, both added.

independent_grade.notes: The diff is a surgical fix for the duplicate-reply-marker case: `shouldResolveThread()` now ignores only the exact trusted duplicate-reply no-op when selecting the effective last comment, so a valid prior addressed/not-applicable marker still resolves the thread while later substantive follow-up remains blocking. The change is narrowly scoped to CI-recovery state logic plus targeted unit and live reconcile regressions, with no unrelated refactors or policy concerns visible in the touched paths.
